Loading file
```{r}
load(file = "../Outputs/gene.exp")
load(file = "../Outputs/pt.char")
load(file = "../Outputs/pt.status")
```
Splitting by cohort and outcome
```{r}
sorting <- function(data, cohort, outcome1, outcome2){
  filter(data, 
         Cohort == cohort, 
         Reason.for.discontinuation == outcome1 | 
           Reason.for.discontinuation == outcome2)  
}
  
train.outcomes <- sorting(pt.status,
                          "Adj",
                          "Therapy complete", 
                          "Progression")

train.outcomes <- arrange(train.outcomes, desc(Sample))


test.outcomes <- sorting(pt.status, 
                        "Adj Validation",
                        "Therapy complete",
                        "Progression")

test.outcomes <- arrange(test.outcomes, desc(Sample))


train.seq <- filter(gene.exp, (Sample %in% train.outcomes$Sample))
train.seq <- arrange(train.seq, desc(Sample))


test.seq <- filter(gene.exp, (Sample %in% test.outcomes$Sample))
test.seq <- arrange(test.seq, desc(Sample))

```
